assets: the AWS account and its stacks (infra/aws/stacks)
the media bucket and its replica (DATA-r2-media)
the doorbell's bearer token and the service's tokens
boundaries: GitHub Actions (the doorbell workflow) and the AWS deploy it rings
the internet and the service's HTTP port

threats.statement: Someone rings the doorbell or calls the service's port without being the merge's workflow or a known tenant.
A deploy runs code that is not main's merged commit, or a session changes production by hand.
A deploy or a production change cannot be traced to the merge that rang it.
A production credential or database URL leaks to a cloud session, a log or the repository.
A deletion, a provider failure or a regional loss takes the database or the media. Residual: a compromised or closed account loses both copies (RISK-media-single-account).

The doorbell's token, held in GitHub's secrets, or a deploy role reaches more than ringing the deploy. Residual: no test bounds the IAM policies of the stacks; their scope is read only in review of the templates.
